title: The deployed site is 381 files short of Cloudflare's free 20,000-file limit

owner_note.text: public/ tracks 19,619 files; Workers Free refuses a deploy over 20,000. A public/.assetsignore with framework/ai/sessions/ drops ~7,300 dev-only files from the upload; it is phase 1 of repo-size.md, left for the next task because it was outside this one's fence.
